titleEn: Fahua jing xianying lu (Records of Evident Responses to the Lotus Sutra)

structureNote.zh: 全書二卷，依人物門類編次：卷首載序文與目次；卷一起「古聖」（佛經所示七事）、「高僧」；卷二續「高僧」，次「高尼」「信男」「信女」，末附刻序。原書目次頁題作「法華經驗應錄目次」，與目錄題名「顯應錄」一字互倒，今依原書如實註記。
structureNote.en: Two fascicles arranged by category of person: prefaced by a foreword and table of contents; juan 1 opens with "Ancient Sages" (seven narratives from the sutra itself) and "Eminent Monks"; juan 2 continues the monks, then "Eminent Nuns", "Laymen", "Laywomen", closing with a colophon. The internal table of contents is titled Fahua jing yan-ying lu (with two characters transposed); this bibliographic variant is recorded as printed.

sections.nameEn: Ancient Sages (narratives within the Lotus Sutra)

titleEn: Fahua jing chiyan ji (Records of Verified Experiences of Upholding the Lotus Sutra)

structureNote.zh: 全書二卷，依朝代先後編次：卷首載自序與勸流通引；正文自六朝（晉）起，歷宋、齊、梁、陳、北魏、北齊、北周、隋、唐（卷一），至吳越、五代、宋、元、明（卷二），末附清代數則。與《顯應錄》門類編次互異，二書同題材者，本站分別保留原典見證。
structureNote.en: Two fascicles arranged chronologically by dynasty: prefaced by the compiler's foreword and an exhortation to circulate the collection; the main text runs from the Six Dynasties (Jin) through Song, Qi, Liang, Chen, Northern Wei, Northern Qi, Northern Zhou, Sui and Tang (juan 1), to Wuyue, the Five Dynasties, Song, Yuan and Ming (juan 2). Its arrangement differs from the categorical order of the Xianying lu; where both works carry the same narrative, this site preserves both primary witnesses separately.
